title: Seeing Right, Writing Wrong: Where Short Chain-of-Thought Breaks Spatial VQA
abstract: arXiv:2611.28665v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Asking a vision-language model (VLM) to think step by step often makes it worse at spatial questions, even though the image stays in context. We show that short chain-of-thought (CoT) turns a perception problem into a transcription problem. Once a VLM writes a spatial relation, its answer follows that sentence instead of the image, so whether CoT helps or hurts depends largely on whether the written relation is more accurate than answering directly. Studying 15 open VLMs (2B-38B) and six frontier closed models, we rule out token count, turn format, and visual forgetting in open models and trace the failure through three stages. First, writing re-weights visual cues, weakening a "lower is closer" shortcut in all 13 open models tested but also discarding valid cues, which produces false relations. translated_title: 看得对，写得错：短思维链在何处破坏空间视觉问答
translated_abstract: 要求视觉语言模型（VLM）逐步思考，往往会使它在空间问题上的表现变差，即使图像仍保留在上下文中。我们证明，短思维链（CoT）将一个感知问题转变成了一个转录问题。一旦VLM写下某个空间关系，它的答案就会跟随那句话而非图像，因此CoT究竟是有帮助还是有损害，很大程度上取决于写下的关系是否比直接回答更准确。通过研究15个开源VLM（2B-38B）和六个前沿闭源模型，我们排除了token数量、轮次格式以及开源模型中的视觉遗忘等因素，并将失败 traced 到三个阶段。第一，书写会重新加权视觉线索：在所测试的全部13个开源模型中，它削弱了“越低越近”的捷径，但同时也会丢弃有效线索，从而产生错误的关系。第二，写下的文本接管了答案：在固定模型自身去除结论的推理文本的情况下，替换为深度相反的图像会使答案……
tldr: 本文揭示短思维链（CoT）损害视觉语言模型空间问答能力的机制：CoT将感知问题变成转录问题，模型一旦写下空间关系，答案便跟随文字而非图像，因此CoT是否有益取决于所写关系的准确程度。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals why short chain-of-thought (CoT) hurts vision-language models on spatial VQA: CoT turns a perception problem into a transcription problem where the answer follows the written spatial relation rather than the image, so CoT helps only when the written relation is more accurate than answering directly.
